commit 84183615abd1434e12a7b7e411cff6a5ace8eaa8
Author:     John Bieling <john@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Sat Jul 4 11:11:14 2026 +0000
Commit:     john@thunderbird.net <john@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Sat Jul 4 11:13:22 2026 +0000

    Bug 2052575 - Stop running xpcshell on the MSIX variant on Windows. r=tobyp
    
    The xpcshell selftest hangs under MSIX (launching the packaged xpcshell as a
    subprocess is pathologically slow), and mozilla-central no longer runs xpcshell
    on MSIX. Disable the msix variant for the xpcshell suite to match.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D310400

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/test/tests.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/test/tests.yml
index 84f1771749c..c6c3ad4dc84 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/test/tests.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/test/tests.yml
@@ -31,7 +31,9 @@ xpcshell:
         by-variant:
             msix:
                 by-test-platform:
-                    windows11-64.*: built-projects
+                    # Disabled: the xpcshell selftest hangs under MSIX. Firefox
+                    # no longer runs xpcshell on MSIX either.
+                    windows11-64.*: []
                     default: []
             default: built-projects
     tier:
title: Bug 2052575 - Stop running xpcshell on the MSIX variant on Windows. r=tobyp
